row.notes: (rules, vehicle u8, force). If the car's bit is set in rules+0x1d08 (DSQ mask) and its entry flags (+0x32 & 0xa0) == 0x20: result record (rules+0x1c68 -> +0x148[id]) -> eDisqualified reason 6 (0x605) and commit. Otherwise if force or the black-flag deadline rules+0x1d10+i*4 (seconds, -1 = none) has passed: Sess_Result_RequestStatus(5, 6) + commit, deadline reset to -1; else sends the OSD black flag timer (log RULES 'sendBlackFlagTimerMessageToOSD %d %d timer', 0x142a50140 msg 0x11/0x2c). Callers Sess_Rules_DisqualifyForPenaltyPoints 0x14356b85d, 0x1505b7147. Addon: DSQ / black flag path; rules+0x1d08 is the DSQ bitmask read by every ruleset. d1-verify-b correction: reason-0x605 disqualify path only when entry+0x30 bit0 == 0; deadline/black-flag timer path is bit0 == 1; deadline array rules+0x1d10 has 2 slots (index 0/1), not per car
